workflow_runs.name: Release
workflow_runs.display_title: fix(security): ignore the Dapr app-token override in Production

head_commit.message:
fix(security): ignore the Dapr app-token override in Production

Since 32fc400e the Dapr application-token middleware honored
Hexalith:Dapr:ApplicationTokenOverride in every environment, and a present
but empty (or null-valued) key turned the sidecar-to-app token check off.
The Production startup validator checked only APP_API_TOKEN and
DAPR_API_TOKEN, so Hexalith__Dapr__ApplicationTokenOverride= in a Production
Server, MCP, AccessTelemetry or Clock pod passed startup unprotected.

The middleware now ignores the override in Production, reads it once at
construction with a direct key lookup instead of walking the configuration
tree per request, and counts only a non-null value as an override. The
startup validator fails Production startup when the key holds a value,
naming the key but never the value. Development test hosts keep the
override. The deployment configuration guide documents the new startup
failure, and the follow-ups are deferred in deferred-work.md.

Refs: epic-27-retro-item-62-honor-hexalith-dapr-applicationtokenover

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

workflow_runs.display_title: docs(telemetry): close Story 27.4 by scope reset and resolve A41 by a…

head_commit.message:
docs(telemetry): close Story 27.4 by scope reset and resolve A41 by accepted debt

Apply the approved Sprint Change Proposal 2026-11-01. Local functional
retention already passed on 2026-10-25 (run 0673d50339f4e1058c26e3a9b2d680a2:
Dapr 1.18.1, PostgreSQL 18.6, verified disposal). Production lifecycle writes
stay disabled, so the 34-checkpoint Production campaign has no consumer.

- Mark Story 27.4 and Epic 27 done; close Spec 14 with its open tasks
  withdrawn, not completed.
- Resolve 20.5-A41-ACCESS-TELEMETRY-RETENTION by accepted debt (DW-17), with
  owner, scope, evidence, risk, compensating controls, reopen trigger, and a
  2027-05-01 review action.
- Park the full Production qualification campaign in DW-730. It reopens only
  when a Production path enables lifecycle writes or runs a lifecycle replica.
- Add the operator control that keeps access-telemetry log/OTLP retention at
  7 days or less, and mark superseded runbook and planning text historical.
- Update the guard tests to pin the new state; no assertion is weakened.
- Record lesson L15: finish on proven behaviour, park the rest behind a
  trigger.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

Require the AppHost, hosting extension and native test fixture image pins to
stay aligned without changing source-publication filtering or erasure guards.
